additional_info.subject: RE: ID0414635-DC/SI-D/CH-[Y2 / S4 313659082001] charger is out of service CRM:00797001801
additional_info.body:
Hi RC-CH Team,
We have observed that the charger was initially online, but it is in Failsafe mode. After rebooting, the charger reverted to Failsafe mode. Upon reviewing the logs, it appears that the PLC & XF4 is not reachable. To resolve this issue, we would like to plan an onsite intervention.
During the intervention, we kindly ask you to verify the following:
Verify Connections:
Ensure that the Ethernet and power connections for the PLC and Router2 are properly secured.
IP Scan:
Use MobXterm to scan the IPs and identify any unreachable IPs, which will help us determine the root cause of the issue and proceed with the necessary actions.
Please refer to the knowledge article attached below, which may help you during troubleshooting.
KA Link:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_SW_PLC,SECC_Failsafe mode error - Dynamics 365
Additionally, to facilitate troubleshooting, we recommend carrying the following spare parts:
A couple of Ethernet cables
A PLC and router
A Live Linux USB and a Cfast card, in case they are required for further diagnostics.
